summary: Add shared Bun TypeScript hook helpers and incremental type checks after each Claude Code edit.
description: Give a TypeScript project on Bun the shared helpers its own Claude Code hooks build on: payload parsing and a shell lexer that reads commands the way bash runs them. For Claude Code, the adapter type-checks the project incrementally after each edit and reports the errors back. Destructive-command and secret guards come from agent-ops; stack hooks built on these helpers only stop commands that would hang the session.
seoDescription: Shared Bun TypeScript hook helpers and incremental TypeScript checking after each Claude Code edit.

projectExamples.title: Dev server guard
projectExamples.description: A stack hook uses the shared shell lexer to stop a foreground dev server that would hold the agent's session open, and points at the background script instead.

projectExamples.title: Type errors after each edit
projectExamples.description: Claude Code sees the TypeScript errors its last edit introduced before it moves on, without running the whole check.

plain.whatItIs: Adds type checking after each Claude Code edit, and shared helpers for hooks, to a TypeScript project that uses Bun, a JavaScript runtime.
goodAt: Showing Claude Code the TypeScript errors its last edit caused
Reading shell commands safely inside a project's own hooks
notGoodAt: Sandboxing untrusted code; use a separate sandbox for that.
Projects that do not use Bun, or that use Cursor instead of Claude Code.
